# Go-to-market workflow

Work in this order: offer and ICP, evidence, list/segment, message, channel,
conversation, proposal, close, handoff, expansion. Maintain a scorecard for
qualified conversations, opportunities, proposals, wins, time-to-next-step, and
revenue. Drafting and analysis are reversible; sending, publishing, purchasing,
and changing live systems require the configured approval.
